The Problem

Lighting gets specified before you know the project exists

Early specification cycle. Lighting is decided in the planning phase, long before construction begins. If you're not in front of the contractor or architect early, you're already too late.

Retrofit invisibility. Existing facilities need lighting upgrades but don't know who to call. Without a strong digital presence, you're missing the upgrade market entirely.

Technical selling online. Lumen output, uniformity ratios, and energy specifications matter, but most lighting websites don't present this information in a way that converts.

FAQ

How do you connect lighting companies with active court projects?

Through our contractor network, we identify new court construction and renovation projects where lighting is being specified and connect your sales team during the decision-making phase.

Can you help with both new installations and retrofit projects?

Yes. We create separate marketing funnels for new construction lighting specifications and retrofit/upgrade projects targeting existing facility owners.

What makes sports court lighting marketing unique?

Lighting is specified early in the project planning phase. Being connected to contractors and architects before ground breaks is critical to getting your systems specified.
